title: DOOH Placement Attributes
description: Digital out-of-home screen and scheduled-loop facts. These fields describe inventory and do not define creative acceptance, which is governed exclusively by effective canonical format_options. Each field is optional and should only be populated when it is uniform across the placement. For publisher_ref placements, product-level slot_duration_seconds and loop_duration_seconds override publisher defaults while omitted values inherit. screen_resolution and motion are intrinsic publisher facts and MUST match when repeated by a product.

slot_duration_seconds.description: Scheduled duration of one ad slot in seconds (e.g., 10, 15, 30). This is an inventory fact used for loop and share calculations, not the creative-duration contract.

loop_duration_seconds.description: Duration of the full ad loop rotation in seconds. Buyers can derive nominal slot share as slot_duration_seconds / loop_duration_seconds. This is the canonical source for loop duration; the pricing-layer field in flat-rate-option.json is superseded by this placement-level declaration.

screen_resolution.description: Physical screen resolution in pixels. Buyers can derive aspect ratio from width/height. This does not replace or broaden canonical format dimensions, which remain authoritative for creative acceptance and may describe a smaller content region within the physical screen.

motion.description: Physical motion capability of the DOOH screen. This is discovery metadata, not an accepted-format declaration; effective format_options determines whether a particular full-motion, partial-motion, or static creative is accepted.
